test_title: PYST 17: SSC CGL 2025 Tier-I Similar Paper - Reasoning (Held On: 17th Sep 2025 Shift 2)
subject: reasoning
question:
Instruction: Identify the assumptions that must hold for the statement to be valid, then choose the correct option.

Statement: The successful deployment of the new quantum satellite has provided empirical evidence for long-distance entanglement, but it also creates opportunities for developing unhackable global communication networks.

Assumptions:

I. Quantum satellites offer a new method for global communication.

II. The theory of entanglement has been fully utilized by this deployment.

III. Further research into quantum entanglement will lead to breakthroughs in cybersecurity. ?

options.text: Only I and II are implicit
Only II and III are implicit
Only I and III are implicit
All I, II, and III are implicit

solution:
Given statement: The successful deployment of the new quantum satellite has provided empirical evidence for long-distance entanglement, but it also creates opportunities for developing unhackable global communication networks.

Assumptions:

I. Quantum satellites offer a new method for global communication. ⇒ Implicit

The statement links the satellite's development to opportunities for global communication networks, which presumes that quantum satellite can be used as a communication method. 

II. The theory of entanglement has been fully utilized by this deployment. ⇒ Not Implicit

The statement does not suggest that the theory of entanglement has been fully utilized, only that that the evidence has been demonstrated. 

III. Further research into quantum entanglement will lead to breakthroughs in cybersecurity. ⇒ Implicit

The statement mentions that unhackable global communication networks assumes that further development of quantum entanglement will contribute to advance in cybersecurity.

Thus, Only I and III are implicit.

Hence, "Option 3" is the correct answer.
